lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in distinct vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, located posterior to the pectoral fin and extending towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs to form a regular grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal ridges on the upper lateral flank characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient, with bright dorsal-facing edges and dark shadowed ventral-facing edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin macro-mask, with a minor concentration near the posterior base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An irregular white mark is visible on the distal tip of the pectoral fin. A distinct, short vertical white line is present on the lower flank immediately posterior to the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, low-diameter spots on the dorsal head region, differing in scale and density from the lateral flank patterning.
